name: Kyoudai o Okashita Haha to Ane
source:
A mother caught her sons and daughter having sex.
She chewed the boys, and they responded with sexual assault.
But that flipped her ladyswitch, and mommy ended up doing them like they never imagined.

Mom and big sis pwn the boys!

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ145581.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一位母亲发现她的儿子和女儿发生性关系。
她咀嚼这些男孩，而他们则以性侵犯作为回应。
但这改变了她的女士开关，妈妈最终做了他们从未想象过的事情。

妈妈和姐姐打败了男孩们！
